task.title: Firewall configuration
task.shortdesc: To allow network access to your proof of concept Red Hat Quay deployment, you can open firewall ports that match your container port mappings. The required ports depend on which services you expose on the host.

context.p: If you have a firewall running on your system, you might have to add rules that allow access to Red Hat Quay.

step.cmd: Enter firewall commands for the ports that you have mapped on your system, for example:

info.codeblock: # firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=80/tcp \ && firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=443/tcp \ && firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=5432/tcp \ && firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=5433/tcp \ && firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=6379/tcp \ && firewall-cmd --reload
